newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Dutch Rabobank's Hungarian unit gets go-ahead.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Rabobank's Hungarian unit gets go-ahead.

text.p: Rabobank Netherlands received the banking supervision permission to set up a Hungarian unit, the bank said on Tuesday.
"The bank will open at the end of the winter or at the beginning of spring (1997)" a Rabobank press release said.
It added that its first Hungarian unit was planned to have some 60-65 employees by the end of March 1997.

Bank officials were not immediately available but they said earlier this year they planned to set up a Hungarian unit with two billion forints ($12.2 million) capital, focusing on Rabobank's traditional businesses in the food and farming sector.
They also said Rabobank planned to spend some $100 million over the next four years in expanding in east Europe.
